what_worked: Visually cohesive branding and clear consulting-style layout with consistent design language.
fix_next: This deck analyzes Meesho logistics, not the assigned 1,000-row startup revenue dataset — it addresses the wrong assignment entirely.
verdict: Wrong dataset, wrong assignment — a polished deck that answers nothing asked.
factual_error_detail: Cannot count factual errors against the frozen dataset because the deck never references it. All claims are about Meesho logistics with no verifiable sourcing.

evidence.insight: No insight derived from the assigned dataset. All claims are generic logistics strategy assertions (slides 3-5) about Meesho's last-mile costs, RTO rates, and kirana networks.
evidence.narrative: The deck has internal coherence as a consulting pitch (problem → economics → solution), but it tells no data story from the assigned dataset.
evidence.framing: Framing is for a Meesho strategy case, not the assigned data-story task. No mention of the 1,000-row dataset, its variables, or any analytical question derived from it.
evidence.accuracy: No claims can be verified against the frozen dataset because none are made. Industry statistics (RTO 20-30%, last-mile 40-55% of cost) are presented without citations. Slide 5 fine print admits numbers are 'indicative.'
evidence.visual: Consistent pink/magenta Meesho branding, clear hierarchy, readable bar charts on slides 4-5, good use of icons. Slide 4 is dense but navigable. Professional template quality.
evidence.ai_slop: Heavy consulting-speak throughout: 'Re-Architecting Last-Mile Through Trust, Density & Behavioural Design,' 'distributed commerce ecosystem,' 'layered logistics architecture.' Decorative icons dominate over data. Projected savings (₹300 Cr) appear fabricated.
